what_this_is: Accuracy of each tier's model on 100 multiple-choice questions, asked once each on the machine described under 'hardware'. A small sample and a single run: read the intervals, not just the percentages.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB

notes: Single run on 2026-10-09. Ollama started with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4, default 4096-token context; other applications were not closed.

questions.name: MMLU (Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding)
questions.authors: Hendrycks, Burns, Basart, Zou, Mazeika, Song, Steinhardt (2021)
questions.selection: random.Random(7).sample(range(14042), 100), sorted, as row numbers of the test split

method.prompt_template_chosen_by: --pilot: three candidate templates on eight made-up questions, before the evaluation set was used
method.scoring: exact match on the option letter the reply opens with; a reply that does not open with A, B, C or D, or a failed request, is wrong

notes: hardware-limited: the model did not fit on the GPU. Ollama had 5% of it on the CPU (7.7 of 8.1 GiB in VRAM) when it was measured. These timings are of this model on hardware too small for it, not of the model.
